description: Write the About section on a DAO's own page: what the caper is for, who runs it and where to follow it. Holders only, the same gate as save_wiki_page. The section is replaced whole, so read the current one first: it is in the DAO's llms.txt and its MCP server's instructions. Pass the body as `html` or as `blocks`, as save_wiki_page takes them. Requires the Bearer token from the `login` tool, sent as an HTTP `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header on the POST carrying this call.

blocks.description:
content blocks – [{ id: uuid, type: "content", text: "

…

" }]; the whole section, replacing the current one. Validated by the editor's own validator. Pass this or `html`.

daoId.description: cashtag of the DAO whose About to write

html.description:
The body as one HTML string, e.g.

…

…

, saved as a standard content block. Pass this or `blocks`.

summary.description: optional edit summary for the section's history
